stem:
Which best combines the two sentences?

Dr. Lim is the new municipal health officer. Dr. Lim will lead the vaccination drive.
choices: Dr. Lim is the new municipal health officer, she will lead the vaccination drive.
Dr. Lim, the new municipal health officer, will lead the vaccination drive.
Dr. Lim will lead the vaccination drive, the new municipal health officer.
Being the new municipal health officer, the vaccination drive will be led by Dr. Lim.
answer: Dr. Lim, the new municipal health officer, will lead the vaccination drive.
hints: The second sentence repeats "Dr. Lim". One of the sentences can shrink into a short phrase that renames Dr. Lim.
"The new municipal health officer" is another name for Dr. Lim. Where should a phrase that renames someone go?

A renaming phrase (an appositive) goes right after the name it renames, with a comma before and after it. Also watch for comma splices and opening phrases that describe the wrong noun. Check each choice.

solution.methodName: Find the link between the ideas, then check the grammar

steps.action: Find the link: "the new municipal health officer" is another name for Dr. Lim. A phrase that renames a noun is called an appositive.
steps.why: Example: "Ana, our cashier, is on leave." "Our cashier" renames Ana.

steps.action: Put the appositive right after "Dr. Lim", between commas: "Dr. Lim, the new municipal health officer, will lead the vaccination drive." Correct.
First choice: two complete sentences joined by only a comma. This is a comma splice. Wrong.
Third choice: the phrase comes after "the vaccination drive", so it seems to rename the drive. Wrong.
Fourth choice: "Being the new municipal health officer" is followed by "the vaccination drive", so the drive seems to be the officer. This is a dangling modifier. Wrong.
The answer is "Dr. Lim, the new municipal health officer, will lead the vaccination drive."

trapNotes.Dr. Lim is the new municipal health offi: Both ideas are kept, but "Dr. Lim is the new …" and "she will lead …" are complete sentences joined by only a comma.
trapNotes.Dr. Lim will lead the vaccination drive,: The renaming phrase is there, but it sits after "the vaccination drive", so it seems to say the drive is the health officer.
trapNotes.Being the new municipal health officer,: This sounds formal, but the first thing after the comma is "the vaccination drive". A drive cannot be a health officer.
